defs.def: to have the skill, intelligence, opportunity, etc. needed to do sth 用作情态动词

ex.s: “If you’re scared about something and thinking only about that, there’s no way you’re going to be able to learn,” Ho says.
ex.t: “如果你对某件事感到害怕而且只想着那件事，你就不可能学得进去，”Ho说。

ex.s: Besides, your parents will also be able to participate in workshops selected just for them to learn about cutting-edge science.
ex.t: 此外，你的父母也能参加专为家长挑选的研讨会，了解前沿科学。

ex.s: Turner wisely said that “doing well” psychologically is being able to roll with the flow of emotions, manage them, communicate clearly and well with others, and master various skills.
ex.t: 特纳明智地说，“从心理上讲”“做得好”是能够顺应情绪的流动，管理情绪，与他人清晰良好地沟通，并掌握各种技能。“

ex.s: It’s being able to show understanding when communicating with others.
ex.t: 我停下脚步，它很快展翅起飞，但并没有立即飞远。

ex.s: After Charlie had a heart attack, Tindale says, she was prepared to put him to sleep, but Farber’s treatments eased her dog’s suffering so much that she was able to keep him alive for an additional five months.
ex.t: Charlie心脏病发作后，Tindale说，她本准备让它安乐死，但Farber的治疗大大减轻了它的痛苦，让她又能让它多活了五个月。

ex.s: They are able to have entire conversations with humans using meows and you're able to interpret it.
ex.t: 它们能用喵喵叫和人类进行完整对话，而你也能听懂。

ex.s: However, another way the cats are able to distinguish between situations is by looking for familiar smells.
ex.t: 不过，猫还能通过寻找熟悉的气味来区分不同的情况，这是它们的另一种方式。

ex.s: That's why most pet cats are able to tell immediately if their owners were around any other cats, which they don't usually like.
ex.t: 这就是为什么大多数宠物猫能立刻察觉主人是否接触过其他猫——而它们通常不喜欢这样。

ex.s: If I ever get trapped outside my house again, my local telephone box will, sadly, no longer be able to connect me with my keys.
ex.t: 如果我再被锁在屋外，可悲的是，我家附近的电话亭将不再能帮我联系到钥匙了。

ex.s: Humans are able to picture a favorable future.
ex.t: 人类能够想象一个美好的未来。

ex.s: Signing up for the programme does not automatically mean that you will be able to register and participate.
ex.t: 报名该项目并不自动意味着你将能够注册并参与。

ex.s: Since there are many factors involved in the pairing process, not all students who sign up will be matched with a partner and be able to register for the programme.
ex.t: 由于配对过程中涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到搭档并注册该项目。

ex.s: Ideally a history would bring together texts and objects, and some chapters of this book are able to do just that, but in many cases we simply can’t.
ex.t: 理想情况下，历史会把文本和实物结合起来，本书的一些章节能够做到这一点，但在许多情况下我们根本做不到。

ex.s: At the end of each session I return home feeling stronger, lighter, more able to carry on.
ex.t: 每次课程结束时，我回到家感觉更强壮、更轻松，更能继续下去。

ex.s: Another study from 2021 tested for “theory of mind” in dogs in a similar way, but the dogs were able to walk round the screen to obtain the treat after witnessing the experimenter’s “unwilling” or “unable” behaviour.
ex.t: 2021年的另一项研究以类似方式测试了狗的“心智理论”，但狗在目睹实验者“不情愿”或“无能为力”的行为后，能够绕到屏幕另一侧去取零食。

ex.s: •You are able to work with people from different backgrounds.
ex.t: •你能够和不同背景的人一起工作。

ex.s: While you are able to pickup a new habit in a few weeks, it takes many months to build a healthy habit.
ex.t: 虽然你可以在几周内养成一个新习惯，但建立一个健康习惯需要好几个月。

ex.s: In the experiment, Goffin’s cockatoos were able to select the right tool for the job, in most cases, by visual recognition alone.
ex.t: 在实验中，Goffin的cockatoos能够选择合适的工作工具，在大多数情况下仅通过视觉识别。

ex.s: How far they are able to see.
ex.t: 他们能看多远。

ex.s: With their ability to see ahead, they could signal any problem, so that fast-moving trains would be able to react in time.
ex.t: 凭借它们的前瞻能力，它们可以发出任何问题的信号，以便高速行驶的火车能及时反应。

ex.s: But something about quantum computing makes it especially prone to hype, Johnson suggests, perhaps because “‘quantum’ stands for something cool you shouldn’t be able to understand.” And that brings me back to Taylor, who suggested that I read his book Q for Quantum.
ex.t: 但量子计算的某些特点使其特别容易受到炒作的影响，Johnson暗示道，也许是因为"'量子'代表着你本不该理解的酷东西。"这让我回到了Taylor身边，他建议我读他的书《Q for Quantum》。

ex.s: “I was turning the page to get ready for the next page, but the draft wind from the turn caused the spare pages to fall off the stand,” Mr Titterton said, “Luckily I was able to catch them and put them back.”
ex.t: “我正翻页准备下一页，但翻页带起的气流把备用的谱子从谱架上吹掉了，”蒂特顿先生说，“幸好我接住了它们并放回去。”

ex.s: What should Titterton be able to do to be a page turner?
ex.t: 蒂特顿要成为翻谱员需要能够做什么？

ex.s: What will Sukkarieh's robot be able to do?
ex.t: 苏卡里耶的机器人将能做什么？

ex.s: In the former case you may be able to read a chapter.
ex.t: 在前一种情况下，你可能能读一章。

ex.s: In the latter you may only be able to read one page.
ex.t: 在后一种情况下，你可能只能读一页。

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 影片制作人大卫·邦德(David Bond)在几年前意识到，他的孩子当时五岁三岁，被贴在屏幕上，以至于他可以在三岁的儿子的耳朵里说"巧克力"而没有得到回应。

ex.s: Dogs may indeed be able to distinguish between happy and angry human faces, according to a new study.
ex.t: 研究人员随后通过向狗展示人脸的另一半或与训练中使用完全不同的图像来测试狗区分人类面部表情的能力。

ex.s: The researchers found that the dogs were able to pick the angry or happy face by touching a picture of it with their noses more often than one would expect by random chance.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，狗能够通过用鼻子触碰图片来选择愤怒或快乐的面孔，其正确率高于随机概率。

ex.s: By taking off these, she was able to   42   the new total to the amount of cash she had with her.
ex.t: 通过去掉这些，她能够把____42____的新总额和她手头的现金对上。

ex.s: 例：Stand over there        you'll be able to see it better.
ex.t: 例：站在那边____，你就能看得更清楚。

ex.s: You should be able to work well in a team and adapt to an international working environment．
ex.t: 你应该能够在团队中良好协作，并适应国际化工作环境。

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活。现在我们的项目结束了，我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命，而是十个。通过我们的努力，十个年轻人现在将能够继续接受教育。

ex.s: She decided to go back to college to advance her career and to be able to better support her family while doing something she loves: nursing.
ex.t: 她决定回到大学深造，以推进自己的事业，并在从事自己热爱的工作——护理——的同时，更好地支撑家庭。

ex.s: She chose the UW-Eau Claire program at Ministry Saint Joseph’s Hospital in Marshfield because she was able to pursue her four-year degree close to home.
ex.t: 她选择了位于马什菲尔德的明斯特圣约瑟夫医院的UW-Eau Claire项目，因为她能在离家近的地方攻读四年制学位。

ex.s: Who might be able to help Tom this week?
ex.t: 这周谁能帮Tom？

ex.s: Who might be able to help Tom this week?
ex.t: 这周谁能帮Tom？

ex.s: If you do, you won’ be able to   59   it and the whole thing develops into an unpleasant scene and that   60   everyone’s day.
ex.t: 如果你那样做，你将无法___59___，整件事会演变成不愉快的场面，从而___60___大家的一天。

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.
ex.t: 通过在添加一层岩盐之前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能能将其岩盐使用量减少30%。

ex.s: His parents were not quite able to keep theirs under control.
ex.t: 他的父母不太能够控制住自己的情绪。

ex.s: Who might be able to help Tom this week?
ex.t: 这周谁能帮Tom？

ex.s: "During a time of stress for families, it's nice to be able to help them smile and laugh," Parry said.
ex.t: “在家长们倍感压力的时候，能帮他们露出笑容和笑声是件好事，”帕里说。

ex.s: Your library might be able to accommodate you.
ex.t: 你的图书馆或许能够满足你的需求。

ex.s: But all of today's excited discussion about these possibilities presupposes the fact that we will be able to build these systems.
ex.t: 但今天关于这些可能性的所有兴奋讨论，都预设了我们将能够建造这些系统这一事实。

ex.s: Dr Prinstein has also found that the qualities that made the neighbors want you on a play date-sharing, kindness, openness — carry over to later years and make you better able to relate and connect with others.
ex.t: 普林斯坦博士还发现，那些让邻居愿意和你一起玩的品质——分享、善良、开放——会延续到以后 years，使你更好地与他人建立联系和沟通。

ex.s: The coach is able to focus on the kids while the other parents are relieved to be off the hook for another season.
ex.t: 教练能够专注于孩子们，而其他家长则因这一季不用操心而松了口气。

ex.s: Many rock bands were able to follow in the footsteps of the Beatles.
ex.t: 许多摇滚乐队能够追随披头士的脚步。

ex.s: Too much praise can backfire and, when given in a way that's insincere, make kids afraid to try new things or take a risk for fear of not being able to stay on top where their parents' praise has put them.
ex.t: 过多的表扬可能适得其反，而且当表扬以不真诚的方式给出时，会让孩子害怕尝试新事物或冒险，担心无法保持在父母表扬把他们放到的那个顶端位置。

ex.s: For many students, Wilson's help is not only appreciated, it's also entirely   26   for them to be able to complete their college education.
ex.t: 对许多学生来说，威尔逊的帮助不仅受感激，而且对他们的大学教育完成也是完全____26____的。

ex.s: Meanwhile, with her parents' help, Moore is generally able to live a normal teenage life.
ex.t: 与此同时，在父母的帮助下，摩尔通常能够过上正常的青少年生活。

ex.s: Armed with  this  knowledge. they're able to carry out individually targeted campaigns to cheat people.
ex.t: 掌握了这一知识，他们就能开展有针对性的个人化活动来欺骗人们。

ex.s: Some 60,000 novels were published during the Victorian age, from 1837 to1901; today a casual reader might be able to name a half-dozen of them.
ex.t: 在维多利亚时代，从1837年到1901年，出版了约6万本小说；今天，一个随便的读者也许可以将其中的六分之一命名。

ex.s: But it was now getting real dark． If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back． My mum would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon． So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared．
ex.t: 但天这会儿真的黑了。如果我继续走，可能看不清回去的路。如果我不快点回家，妈妈会担心死的。所以我几乎是摸黑跑回家，努力不让自己太害怕。

ex.s: The pair were later able to thank Mr Smith for his    25   .
ex.t: 两人后来得以向史密斯先生为他的____25____致谢。

ex.s: If I could locate the nest, I might have been able to put it back, but no luck.
ex.t: 如果我能找到鸟巢，也许就能把它放回去，但运气不好，没找到。

ex.s: They hoped that wolves would be able to control the elk and coyote problems.
ex.t: 他们希望狼能够控制麋鹿和土狼的问题。

ex.s: If everyone is giving you the same answer, you won’t be able to use it.
ex.t: 如果每个人都给你同样的答案，你就没法利用它。

ex.s: If the plot, characters, or word usage is confusing for you, likely won’t be able to remember what you read.
ex.t: 如果情节、人物或用词让你困惑，你很可能记不住读过什么。

ex.s: But he is providing a few years during which the farmers will, perhaps, be able to find other means of adapting.
ex.t: 但他争取到了几年时间，农民或许能在其间找到其他的适应办法。

ex.s: Parents ought to be able to opt out only for limited medical or religious reasons.
ex.t: 父母应当只有在有限的医疗或宗教原因下才能选择退出。

ex.s: Machines with specific purposes are associated with living things partly because they might be able to        .
ex.t: 有特定用途的机器之所以与生物相关联，部分是因为它们或许能够____。

ex.s: I'm afraid I won't be able to meet you this time, but you'll always be my dear friend.
ex.t: 恐怕这次我没法见你了，但你永远是我亲爱的朋友。

ex.s: They have found out that the monarch is able to tell the time of day.
ex.t: 他们发现帝王蝶能够辨别一天中的时间。

ex.s: We could also say In the digital age, we are able to find people who have the same interests as we do, such as collecting model cars or playing an unusual instrument.
ex.t: 我们还可以说，在数字时代，我们能够找到与我们有着相同兴趣的人，比如收集模范汽车或者演奏一种不寻常的乐器。

ex.s: Then you'll be able to train your brain to select healthy food in real situations.
ex.t: 然后你就能训练你的大脑在真实的场景中选择健康的食物。

ex.s: So, if you're a sugar addict and aren't able to say no to chocolate or cola, you had better download it now!
ex.t: 所以，如果你是个嗜糖者，无法对巧克力或可乐说不，你最好现在就下载它！

defs.def: intelligent; good at sth 有才智的；有才能的；（某方面）擅长的

ex.s: We need to exit the things that don’t work anymore to be able to enter the ones that make sense for who we are today.
ex.t: 我们需要放弃那些不再有效的事情，才能进入那些对我们今天来说有意义的事物。

ex.s: Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find redatively easy to meet.
ex.t: Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会觉得这是很容易满足的要求。

ex.s: Mann said Terrafugia was helped by the Federal Aviation  Administration’s decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find relatively easy to meet.
ex.t: 曼说，Terrafugia得益于联邦航空管理局五年前做出的为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独标准的决定，这些标准低于大型飞机飞行员所需的标准。Terrafugia表示，车主需要通过一项测试并完成20小时的飞行时间才能驾驶Transition，飞行员会觉得这是很容易满足的要求。

ex.s: A good thinker is able to inspire other people.
ex.t: 一个好的思考者能够激励其他人。

ex.s: And the Good Morning Britain presenter says she’s been able to put a lot of what she’s leant into practice in her own home, preparing meals for sons, Sam, 14, Finn, 13, and Jack, 11.
ex.t: 这位《早安英国》主持人说，她已能把学到的很多东西付诸自家实践，为14岁的萨姆、13岁的芬恩和11岁的杰克三个儿子做饭。
